name: Call for applications for social innovations under the project „Inkubator Włączenia Społecznego 2.0”
program: European Funds for Social Development 2021-2027 (FERS), Priority Axis V, Measure 5.1: Social innovations (ESF+)
operator: Regional Social Policy Centre in Kraków (ROPS), in partnership with Krakowskie Centrum Innowacyjnych Technologii INNOAGH sp. z o.o.
eligibility: individuals who live in Poland (within the meaning of the Civil Code) and have full legal capacity
legal persons (in particular foundations, associations, capital companies and cooperatives, including social cooperatives)
organisational units that are not legal persons but have legal capacity under the law (in particular general partnerships, limited partnerships and limited joint-stock partnerships)
public finance sector units
informal groups of the individuals or entities listed above, represented by one member of the informal group

formFields.label: Title of the innovation
formFields.hint: Think about the title. It should be short and clearly linked to what the innovation is about

formFields.label: Details of the person or organisation with the idea
formFields.hint: On the online form, choose from the list: individual, entity or informal group (up to 5 partners and a representative named for day-to-day contact).

formFields.label: Description of the innovation
formFields.hint: What is the innovation? What type is it, for example a product, an app, a way of working, a technological solution? How can it be briefly defined and described? How does the solution meet the project's goal: supporting social inclusion / preventing social exclusion? How does the solution fit the idea of deinstitutionalisation?

formFields.label: How innovative the solution is
formFields.hint: Help us better understand what makes the idea unique. Are similar solutions used in Poland or around the world? How does the proposed project bring new value to solving the problem identified? What makes the project stand out from others carried out in this area?

formFields.label: Assessment of the problem your innovation responds to
formFields.hint: What problem does the innovation respond to? Give statistics that show the scale of the problem. What is this assessment based on, for example reports or research? Does the problem you intend to solve match a topic listed in the Social Challenges Map (Mapa Wyzwań Społecznych)? If so, which one?

formFields.label: Description of the people the innovation is for
formFields.hint: Who is your innovation aimed at? What makes this group distinct? What are their needs? Why are these people excluded or at risk of exclusion?

formFields.label: The change the innovation brings
formFields.hint: How will the proposed solution affect the problem described above? What will it change in the lives of the target group? How will it affect the social inclusion of the people it is aimed at? How will it prevent the process of social exclusion?

formFields.label: Vision for the future of the innovation
formFields.hint: Does the innovation have the potential to be used in the future on a large scale, for a wide group of recipients? Can the solution developed be extended to other target groups, or used in a different context or place? How? What features of it allow such an extension? Describe how easy the solution is to use and to implement

formFields.label: Action plan and costs
formFields.hint: Describe in a few key steps what needs to be done, when and at what cost, to prepare and test the innovation. For each activity: Activity, Completion date, Cost of the activity. Preparation period (may not exceed 3 months) and testing period — Phase I and Phase II of the test (may not exceed 9 months).

formFields.label: Grant amount requested
formFields.hint: What is the total grant amount requested? Check it against the partial costs presented in the action plan

formFields.label: Project team and its experience
formFields.hint: Who will be responsible for carrying out the tasks in the project? What experience do these people, institutions and organisations have in working with the recipients of the innovation, and in planning and implementing social innovations?

formFields.label: Declarations
formFields.hint: Declarations for a natural person or for a representative of an entity, made under penalty of criminal liability (Article 297 § 1 of the Criminal Code).

criteria.label: Innovativeness
criteria.description: Assessment of the solution in terms of its potential to solve the identified social problems in a new way, or in a way that is significantly changed compared with existing solutions. The innovativeness of the solution is assessed at national level for the given target group. The applicant's task is to describe the proposed approach against the most similar existing solutions in the country.
criteria.cardDescription: Assessment of the solution in terms of its potential to solve the identified social problems in a new way, or in a way that is significantly changed compared with existing solutions. The innovativeness of the solution is assessed at national level for the given target group.

criteria.label: Relevance to the needs of recipients and users
criteria.description: Are the aims/products of the social innovation relevant to the current assessment of the needs and problems of the target group at national level? To what extent does the social innovation respond to the needs of the target group? To what extent does the social innovation have a chance of contributing to social change, that is, a change in the situation of the target group at national level?
criteria.cardDescription: Analysis of the aims/products of the social innovation in terms of how well they match the current assessment of the needs and problems of the target group nationwide. How responsive is it to the needs of the users, and what is its potential to contribute to social change, i.e. to changing the situation of the target group nationwide? Does the idea respond to a challenge in line with the Social Challenges Map (Mapa Wyzwań Społecznych)?

criteria.label: Cost-effectiveness
criteria.description: Assessment of the degree of optimisation, the ratio of inputs to planned results, and the balance of potential positive and negative effects of the social innovation.
criteria.cardDescription: Assessment of the degree of optimisation, the ratio of inputs to planned results, and the balance of potential positive and negative effects of the social innovation; analysis of whether the stated costs (time, money and resources) are reasonable in relation to the planned results.

criteria.label: Universality
criteria.description: Assessment of whether the solution can be used in different places, how easy it is to use, how easy it is to implement, and whether it can be spread and scaled up.
criteria.cardDescription: Assessment of whether the solution can be used in different places, how easy it is to use, how easy it is to implement, and whether it can be spread and scaled up.

criteria.label: Vision for developing the idea in the future
criteria.description: Assessment of ideas for using the innovation in the future.
criteria.cardDescription: Assessment of ideas for using the innovation after the incubation stage and testing have been completed.

notes: A grant to develop and test a social innovation aimed at people who are socially excluded or at risk of social exclusion; it cannot be an implementation project. Nationwide scope. Maximum amount PLN 120,000 (call for proposals page and the Call for Proposals Notice); average grant value PLN 70,000 according to the project page (https://rops.krakow.pl/realizowane-projekty-i-zadania/inkubator-wlaczenia-spolecznego-20,o-projekcie). No own contribution is required; the grant covers 100% of costs. Duration up to 12 months: a preparation period of up to 3 months, and two testing phases plus refinement totalling up to 9 months; at least 4 testers. An applicant may submit a maximum of 2 applications. Assessment: formal → content → strategic. Part A of the content assessment (5 criteria, 0–10 points each, max. 50): minimum 21 points, including at least 5 points for innovativeness and 4 points for each of the other criteria (Content Assessment Form; Procedures, Chapter IX). Part B (pitching, 3 criteria of 0–5 points each: testing concept, applicant's potential, consistency with the idea of deinstitutionalisation; at least 3 points in each). Applications with at least 32.5 out of 65 points go through to the strategic assessment. Planned decision date: the call for proposals page states "April/May 2025", the Call for Proposals Notice states "March 2025".

name: Call for proposals for the pilot implementation of social services based on innovative solutions under the project "Usługa Wrażliwa – upowszechnianie innowacji społecznych w środowiskach lokalnych"
operator: Regional Social Policy Centre in Kraków (ROPS)
eligibility: organisations with their registered office or a branch in Małopolska, in particular local government and its organisational units such as social welfare centres (OPS), county family support centres (PCPR), social services centres (CUS), as well as NGOs and social economy entities,

organisations with at least 3 years' experience in at least one area related to the subject of the solution: working with the target group the innovation is aimed at, providing a similar form of support, or working in the field of innovation,
organisations that are not excluded from receiving support, in accordance with the Grant Rules, available in the downloadable files.
notes: A grant for a pilot implementation of an innovative social service in a local community, based on one of the innovations selected by ROPS (Framework Implementation Plans). No own contribution is required; the grant covers 100% of the costs. Depending on the innovation, the support is for: families with children, children and young people, people who need support in daily life and their carers, people with disabilities or with limited mobility, people who live, study or work in the Małopolska region; also social services staff. The website does not give the average grant amount (amountAvg = null). The application fields and assessment criteria are in the PDF files „Wniosek o grant” and „Wzór karty oceny merytorycznej” in the downloads section — they have not been copied here (formFields and criteria are empty, minScore = null). Planned decision date according to the list of calls for proposals (https://rops.krakow.pl/nabory-szkolenia-granty-dotacje-wizyty-studyjne-studia-specjalizacje-superwizje/granty-na-innowacje-spoleczne).

name: Usługa Wrażliwa — sample call (demo)
operator: Regional Social Policy Centre in Kraków (ROPS)
eligibility: social welfare centres (OPS) and social services centres (CUS) in Małopolska
county family support centres (PCPR) in Małopolska
non-governmental organisations (NGOs) and social economy entities with a registered office or branch in Małopolska

formFields.label: Aim of the service
formFields.hint: What problem in your community will the service solve? What should change for the people who use it?

formFields.label: Target group and its size
formFields.hint: Who will use the service? How many people do you plan to support, and how do you know that number?

formFields.label: Scope of the service
formFields.hint: What kinds of support will the service include? Where, how often and by whom will it be provided?

formFields.label: Stages and timetable
formFields.hint: List the stages — preparation, launch, running the service, review — with approximate months.

formFields.label: Staff
formFields.hint: Who will provide the service? What qualifications and experience do they have? How many posts or working hours do you expect?

formFields.label: Partners
formFields.hint: Who are you working with on the service (for example the municipality, a school, an organisation, a health centre)? What is each partner's role?

formFields.label: Budget (an estimate to be checked)
formFields.hint: The main cost categories and your estimate for each. ROPS checks the amounts when assessing the application — they do not have to be final.

formFields.label: Risks
formFields.hint: What could go wrong (for example too few participants, no staff, delays) and how will you prevent it?

formFields.label: Indicators
formFields.hint: How will you know the service works? Give indicators (for example the number of people supported) and how you will measure them.

formFields.label: Chosen innovation from the Library
formFields.hint: Which innovation from the Biblioteka Innowacji Społecznych (with its implementation plan, „Ramowy Plan Wdrożenia”) do you want to put into practice, and why this one?

criteria.label: Response to the local community's needs
criteria.description: Does the application show what problem exists in this community, who it affects and why the service is needed here?

criteria.label: Fit with the innovation's implementation plan
criteria.description: Does the service faithfully put the chosen Library innovation into practice, and are any changes to its implementation plan justified?

criteria.label: Feasibility: staff, partners and timetable
criteria.description: Do the staff, partners and stages make it realistic to launch and run the service in the planned time?

criteria.label: A sensible budget
criteria.description: Do the estimated costs follow from the scope of the service and match the number of people it supports?

criteria.label: Sustainability and risks
criteria.description: Does the application describe the risks, how to prevent them, and what happens to the service after the grant ends?

notes: A demonstration call for the prototype, modelled on the „Usługa Wrażliwa” project (ROPS Kraków, FEM, Measure 6.23). The form fields follow the sections of an implementation plan („Ramowy Plan Wdrożenia”). The assessment criteria are samples prepared for the prototype — they do not come from ROPS's assessment form. The maximum amount is the same as in the second „Usługa Wrażliwa” call; no dates are given. This is not a call announced by ROPS.
